subject: dirt hole
text: The dirt hole in the Zora's Domain area is the only hole without a Skulltula, so dumping bugs into it is unnecessary.

evidence.quote: NOTE: The dirt hole in this area is the only hole without a Skulltula, so...don't go nuts trying to dump bugs in it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At the entrance to Zora's River, rolling into the nearby tree knocks a Skulltula loose.

evidence.quote: Although you can't go very far in Zora's River without Bombs, you can still...reach the nearby tree at the entrance.  Roll into it to knock a Skulltula...loose.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night at the waterfall in Zora's River, a Skulltula crawls on the ladder in the water and can be shot with the Slingshot.

evidence.quote: Once you reach the waterfall, hop down into the water and you should see a...ladder.  At night, there's a Skulltula crawling on it.  Slingshot it and...climb up to claim it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: About a third of the way up Zora's River at night, a Skulltula is high on the wall on the right side and can be reached with the Hookshot from the big platform.

evidence.quote: About a third of the way up the river is a Skulltula high on the wall on...the right side.  You can reach it by climbing up to the big platform...nearby, and Hookshot from there.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: About two-thirds of the way up Zora's River near a wooden bridge at night, a Skulltula is high up to the left and can be targeted with the Hookshot or Longshot.

evidence.quote: About two-thirds of the way up the river, about when you reach a wooden...bridge, look up and to the left to see a Skulltula rather high up.  It's an...easier mark with the Longshot, but you can use the Hookshot if you hop onto...the platform's guardrail.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In Zora's Domain at night, a Skulltula is located on the wall to the left of where the Diving Game proprietor used to be and can be retrieved with the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Head to the location where the Diving Game's proprietor used to be.  Look...out and to the left to see a Skulltula on the wall.  Longshot it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At the back of Zora's Fountain on the piece of dry land, rolling into the tree knocks a Skulltula down from its branches.

evidence.quote: Make your way to the back of the area, with the piece of dry land.  Roll...into the tree there and knock a Skulltula from its branches.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At Zora's Fountain at night, a Skulltula on the log sticking out of the water can be shot with the Slingshot and retrieved with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: There's a log sticking out of the water.  Climb up to the highest point on...it and you should be able to see the Skulltula.  Slingshot it and use the...Boomerang to retrieve the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At the back of Zora's Fountain, lifting the gray rock with Silver Gauntlets and bombing the hole leads to an underground passage with a Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Make your way to the back of the area, with the piece of dry land.  Use the...Gauntlets to pick up the gray rock lying here.  Set a Bomb to blow open the...small hole and drop down.  Make your way up this passage to find the...Skulltula.  Beware, because the passage is occupied by big Skulltulas that...you can only see with the Lens of Truth.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At Lake Hylia at night, a Skulltula is found on one of the posts of the lonely platform to the left of the dead tree platform.

evidence.quote: Swim out a lonely platform to the left of a platform with a big dead tree.  ...There's a Skulltula on one of the posts at night.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Next to the Lakeside Laboratory, dumping a Bottle of Bugs into the soft earth hole forces out a Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Next to the Lakeside Laboratory is a patch of soft earth.  Dump a Bottle of...Bugs into the hole on that patch to force out a Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: On the back of the Lakeside Laboratory at night, a Skulltula can be retrieved with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: On the back of the Lakeside Laboratory is a Skulltula.  Use the Boomerang to...retrieve it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: On the Lake Hylia island with the dead tree, using the Longshot to reach its branches leads to a Skulltula.

evidence.quote: On the island with the dead tree, Longshot up to its branches and you'll find...a Skulltula up here.

subject: Gold Skulltula
object: crate at bottom of Lakeside Laboratory
text: Inside the Lakeside Laboratory, rolling into the crate at the bottom reveals a Skulltula that can be killed and retrieved with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Inside the laboratory, drop down to the bottom.  Roll into the crate down...there to find a Skulltula.  Use the Hookshot to kill and retrieve it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In Basement 1 of Jabu-Jabu's Belly, a Skulltula is on the vine wall in the room with the water trench and switch.

evidence.quote: The room this Skulltula's in is a room with a trench of water in the middle,...and you step on a switch to raise the water to a level at which you can...climb out.  The Skulltula's on the nearby vine wall.  You can climb up to...him.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: After destroying the green tentacle in Jabu-Jabu's Belly, dropping through its hole from the first floor leads to a nearby Skulltula in Basement 1.

evidence.quote: After destroying the green tentacle, go the room on the first floor with...several holes leading to the basement.  Drop down the hole that the green...tentacle used to occupy and you should be able to reach a nearby Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A second Skulltula in Basement 1 of Jabu-Jabu's Belly is located in the same general room accessed by dropping down the hole where the green tentacle was.

evidence.quote: After destroying the green tentacle, go the room on the first floor with...several holes leading to the basement.  Drop down the hole that the green...tentacle used to occupy and you should be able to reach a nearby Skulltula.  ...Yes, this is exactly what I wrote for #54.  They're in the same general...place.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: On the first floor of Jabu-Jabu's Belly, a Skulltula is on the vine wall in the final room before the boss.

evidence.quote: This room is the very last room before the boss of this area, in which you...have to Boomerang a switch to move on.  The Skulltula is on the vine wall...heading up there.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At the bottom of Gerudo Valley canyon, dumping a Bottle of Bugs into the dirt hole forces out a Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Grab the chicken near the bridge and leap off the canyon, floating down and...to the right towards the stretch of land at the bottom.  Down here, there is...a small dirt hole.  Dump a Bottle of Bugs onto the hole to force out a...Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Walking up the plank leading to the big bridge in Gerudo Valley at night reveals a Skulltula to the right that can be retrieved with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: As you walk up the plank leading to the big bridge, turn right.  If it's...night, you should see a Skulltula.  Use the Boomerang to retrieve the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley at night, a Skulltula is located on the wall behind the tents and can be hooked with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Either use Epona or the Longshot to cross the broken bridge.  Look behind...the tents and you'll see a Skulltula on the wall.  Hookshot it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley at night, a Skulltula is on the back of the stone pillar to the left and can be Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Either use Epona or the Longshot to cross the broken bridge.  Look behind...the stone pillar off to your left to find a Skulltula on it.  Hookshot it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the entrance room of the Forest Temple, looking up and to the right reveals a Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In the very entrance of the temple, look up and to your right to find the...first Skulltula of this dungeon.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Forest Temple room with four torches, a Skulltula is high up on the wall near the door opposite the entrance.

evidence.quote: In the room with four torches, head to the door opposite from the door you...first enter.  You'll find the Skulltula on the nearby wall rather high up.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the northeast room of the Forest Temple with big Deku Babas, a Skulltula is on the wall and can be reached using the Hookshot on the island chest.

evidence.quote: In the northeast room (with big Deku Babas), you can find this Skulltula on...the wall.  To get to it, you can just make it by using the Hookshot on the...chest on the island, although it's easier to come in from the nearby room,...which you fall into from the second "twisted room".

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the northwest room of the Forest Temple, entering from the second floor and crossing the thin columns leads to a Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In the northwest room (with big Deku Babas), enter from the second floor and...cross the thin columns to reach this Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: After descending the elevator to Basement 1 of the Forest Temple, pushing the rotating room walls reveals a Skulltula in one of the alcoves.

evidence.quote: After descending the elevator to the room you can rotate, push the walls and...examine all the alcoves.  One has a Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
object: room past Song of Time block
text: In the Fire Temple, climbing the entrance stairs, taking the right door, and playing the Song of Time to move the blue block leads to a room with a Skulltula on the wall.

evidence.quote: After entering, climb the stairs and take the door on the right.  Play the...Song of Time to move the blue block, then proceed and enter the next room.  ...You'll find Mr. Skulltula on a wall in that room.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: On the third floor of the Fire Temple, bombing a wall on the far north side of the rolling rock room reveals a Skulltula.

evidence.quote: On the eastern side of the third floor is a room with rocks rolling around.  ...Make your way to the far north side and bomb a wall there to find a...Skulltula.  You should be able to hear it skritching around.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the fifth floor room of the Fire Temple where the Megaton Hammer is found, a Skulltula is near the entrance.

evidence.quote: In the very room you get the Megaton Hammer, look for this Skulltula near the...entrance.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Fire Temple, knocking the entrance pillar aside leads past the first room to a room with spinning tiles where a Skulltula is on the wall.

evidence.quote: In the entrance room, knock the pillar out of the way and proceed through.  ...Once you pass the first room, you'll come to a room with spinning tiles.  The...Skulltula is on the wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Fire Temple, playing the Scarecrow Song near the northwestern exit summons Pierre, allowing Link to Longshot to him and reach a fifth floor area with a Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Go the same room as #67, and make your way to the upper part of the room.  ...Near the northwestern exit, play the Scarecrow Song to make Pierre appear.  ...Longshot to him, and then to the nearby target.  Ride up and make your way...to the fifth floor area.  You'll find the Skulltula close by.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Ice Cavern room with the Heart Piece and Compass, a Skulltula is inside a small niche on the wall.

evidence.quote: In the room with the Heart Piece and the Compass, you'll find this Skulltula...in a little niche on the wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Ice Cavern room with the spinning ice blade and silver gems, a Skulltula is located behind a cluster of icicles.

evidence.quote: In the room with the spinning ice blade and silver gems, you'll find a...Skulltula behind a bunch of icicles.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Ice Cavern room with the pushable ice blocks, a Skulltula is on a nearby wall.

evidence.quote: In the room with the ice blocks you push around, you can find this...Skulltula on a nearby wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Water Temple after draining the water, heading south into the corridor and using the Whirling Blade Technique on the crystal switch reveals a Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Drain all the water and head south into a corridor.  Once you reach the end...of the corridor, use the Whirling Blade Technique to hit the crystal...switch.  Take out the Skulltula on the other side.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Water Temple underground river, dropping into the water wearing the Iron Boots reveals a Skulltula on the left wall.

evidence.quote: After dropping down into the underground river, hop into the water (with...the Iron Boots on), and keep an eye on the left wall.  You'll eventually...see the Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Inside the central pillar of the Water Temple, a Skulltula can be reached from the second floor.

evidence.quote: Inside the pillar in the middle of the temple, you can find this Skulltula...reachable from the second floor.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At the top of the pillar area in the Water Temple, heading west to the moving platforms room allows the Longshot to retrieve a Skulltula on the far right wall.

evidence.quote: At the top of the pillar area, head west to a room with moving platforms.  ...Use the Longshot to hit a Skulltula on the far right wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: On the way to the Boss Key in the Water Temple, a Skulltula is on the wall at the source of rolling rocks and can be grabbed with the Longshot.

evidence.quote: While going for the Boss Key, you'll find a corridor with rolling rocks.  ...When you reach the source of one of those series of rolling rocks, you'll...see a Skulltula on the wall.  Longshot it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Bottom of the Well, taking the northeast door from the central room leads to a room with a Like-Like and a Skulltula.

evidence.quote: From the large room in the center of the dungeon, take the northeast door.  ...Avoid holes and bad guys and make your way to a room with a Like-Like.  The...Skulltula is in this room.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Bottom of the Well, unlocking the left locked room in the center area reveals a Skulltula that can be grabbed with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Find a key and unlock the left of the two rooms in the center room.  Use the...Boomerang to grab the Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Bottom of the Well, unlocking the right locked room in the center area and using the Lens of Truth around the pit allows the Skulltula to be retrieved with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Find a key and unlock the right of the two rooms in the center room.  Use...the Lens of Truth to find the safe path around the outside of the pit and...grab the Skulltula with the Boomerang.
